lxc_9805fdec2abc426a.text: First, we look at what Fishing Spirits is and where its two names come from.

lxc_02397901ed79bd1c.text: Next, we see how you play the arcade game and why the people who made it made it this way.

lxc_469c1a5f6500a31b.text: Then we look at the two Nintendo Switch games and what is inside the 2022 game.

lxc_e1a727d1c3156047.text: Finally, we think about why people may enjoy it.

lxc_b8a567077831621b.text: Fishing Spirits is a series of fishing video games from the Japanese company Bandai Namco.

lxc_576874b3e4d27fd3.text: In Japan, the name is Tsuri Spirits.

lxc_5a378af4e2c08eb4.text: Outside Japan, the series has a different name: Ace Angler.

lxc_a9a42590408d5525.text: An “angler” is a person who fishes with a long stick and line.

lxc_cd735f00102fae41.text: The series did not start on a home game system.

lxc_05fde623954f9783.text: It started in public places with game machines, in November 2012.

lxc_06fc462f01b5c91b.text: An arcade is a public place with game machines, often in a shopping centre.

lxc_09c3f37021828cb3.text: Fishing Spirits was a medal game.

lxc_1332b0e77c515615.text: In a medal game, players win medals, like small coins, and use them to keep playing.

lxc_415f9221063a68d0.text: So when people say "Fishing Spirits," they may mean the whole series.

lxc_1626d805c178d08e.text: They may also mean one game.

lxc_f79efd3485730709.text: We will come back to this idea in Part 4.

lxc_828e2e0f02716719.text: In the arcade, you do not hold a usual game controller.

lxc_f6a067136c4683f1.text: You hold one shaped like a fishing rod.

lxc_c81aabafba2974bd.text: In front of you is a large screen with water and fish.

lxc_cbda1ce1191651d6.text: First, you throw your fishing line into the water.

lxc_3cea0babd580b944.text: Then you wait for a fish to eat the food on the hook.

lxc_9ee88b86c4c212b0.text: You do not see the fish clearly at first.

lxc_0c62abe88bcf969a.text: You only see a dark shape under the water.

lxc_8cc39568ed35102e.text: When a fish bites, the long stick in your hands shakes.

lxc_36643b9c0d18dc3d.text: Now you can see the whole fish.

lxc_690d75cc6b4843fa.text: It might be small, or it might be very big.

lxc_3ef803f6b6c39c2c.text: Next, you turn the handle to bring the fish in.

lxc_44fe82f780913a0b.text: The handle pushes back against your hand, so it feels like a real fish is pulling.

lxc_f3d35077e2a1a327.text: Some fish are hard to catch.

lxc_c24062b5ffc6a19c.text: For these fish, you can push a button for a lightning attack.

lxc_8aa3f9ee15eb33cf.text: This electric attack in the game helps you win the fight.

lxc_ad287dbef57c4375.text: Tougher fish give you more points.

lxc_8fe1dcff18f92924.text: The biggest fish are called Monster Class fish, and they are huge.

lxc_946f980d8290a18b.text: More than one person can play on the machine, so friends can fish side by side.

lxc_2d5bc2aa5e0de12f.text: The company said it designed the game for children.

lxc_af80ab26c7daefc5.text: This included children who had never been fishing in real life.

lxc_ba3b31dc005a6015.text: This was a problem for the designers.

lxc_ded821f4e870bd42.text: Real fishing can be difficult, and a small child may not know what to do.

lxc_819b422e52bc0ed3.text: So the designers chose simple controls.

lxc_634cc07cc7b5a5fb.text: A child only needs to cast, wait and turn the reel.

lxc_1445aedd76acd16b.text: At the same time, they made the screen and the rod look realistic.

lxc_9429e537dbeede87.text: Because the controls are easy, a child can play quickly.

lxc_10d2628c83e356e6.text: Because the game looks real, it still feels exciting.

lxc_8b760945c2ce55d1.text: The company also described what happened around the machines.

lxc_3a7ec9d3c55680b4.text: People who were walking past stopped to watch and cheer.

lxc_18fc5b81f8990d29.text: These are the company's own observations, not a study of every player.

lxc_1fca1b65f2571112.text: Still, they show something important: one person plays, but many people can share the moment.

lxc_6fcc1fd308b17d15.text: Later, the series moved from arcades into people's homes.

lxc_76bddd70571aca4e.text: The first Switch game came out in 2019.

lxc_dba4be0b62a66adc.text: Its name was Ace Angler: Nintendo Switch Version.

lxc_c0188a007a5ce621.text: Then Bandai Namco made a sequel, a new game that follows an earlier one.

lxc_b7aca755b7970153.text: The sequel is called Ace Angler: Fishing Spirits.

lxc_50fcbd78644f1c18.text: In July 2022, the company announced it.

lxc_467abc2bd81c5852.text: It came out on October 27, 2022 in Japan and Asia, and on October 28, 2022 in the United States.

lxc_01f6374e3fd44dce.text: Here, the names can be confusing.

lxc_a9349bf3271ab1e4.text: "Fishing Spirits" is the name of the whole series, which began in 2012.

lxc_0a1efdcfc7648e78.text: "Ace Angler: Fishing Spirits" is only one game, from 2022.

lxc_9dc5cbdf22e70eae.text: So the series is ten years older than this game.

lxc_59d3c9e919b0ab57.text: The 2022 game is a part of the series, not the whole series.

lxc_baa005cd14267108.text: Ace Angler: Fishing Spirits tries to bring the arcade feeling into the home.

lxc_aabc32faa17bcd49.text: The game takes place in Marine Medal Mania.

lxc_f1112a92d7bae9d9.text: This is an amusement park built around an aquarium.

lxc_ef810f26c78c80fb.text: Inside the park, there are different attractions.

lxc_fa7b32bfafd55bcb.text: Ace Angler+ is the arcade fishing game.

lxc_6655464952667be4.text: Instead, you shake and spin the Joy-Con controllers to cast and reel.

lxc_e12785c5bf39d849.text: There is also a story mode, and in the story you help save seas that are dirty with pollution.

lxc_c2385be6c52ccba0.text: There are party minigames with sea animals, like Gator Panic and Goldfish Scooping.

lxc_e543b7b49ff12465.text: Shark Fever is a medal-pusher game.

lxc_ef8e88b7d313fc51.text: There is also online competition with other players.

lxc_cdc75f8b805cf2d6.text: You win medals in the game from these attractions.

lxc_a306ef2e326e39d2.text: Then you use the medals to get fish and to make your aquarium better.

lxc_29090ca63465c185.text: You can collect more than 250 species and show them in your own aquarium.

lxc_a892d42a113806d0.text: Some are real and famous, like great white sharks and giant squid.

lxc_3ba7afaea7846313.text: With a viewing camera, you can look closely at them and learn about them.

lxc_6dd8b41f81996987.text: A fish expert, Karibu Suzuki, checked the fish facts.

lxc_3fdef1429dbc1a19.text: The number of players changes with the mode.

lxc_c71e55a7cf08f325.text: One to four people can play on one Switch.

lxc_412758c4e041e9c7.text: Online, two to four people can play together.

lxc_c4d6e0595fc24686.text: The game teaches facts about sea animals.

lxc_d03a2aee1ed34677.text: However, it does not teach all real fishing skills.

lxc_1123a7daa4390cf7.text: The first reason is easy controls.

lxc_de1b06135d08810e.text: From the start, the series was made for children with no fishing experience.

lxc_77eeead2f5674ab6.text: You do not need special skills to begin.

lxc_a1e8b75b43e81eab.text: You move your body when you play.

lxc_c8a4cbb03af5cd8c.text: In the arcade, you hold a rod and turn a reel.

lxc_48d6fe2884ae19ec.text: On the Switch, you shake and spin the controllers.

lxc_5b7c4bf1316b2cf4.text: This makes the game feel active.

lxc_b0f12265c9107479.text: A fish first appears as a shadow, so you do not know what is coming.

lxc_00e60834031c9110.text: When it bites, you may find a small fish or a Monster Class giant.

lxc_7e41543e66ea00a8.text: A big catch feels like a reward.

lxc_a2fe9fea00e52b20.text: In the arcade, parents joined their children and others cheered.

lxc_8efe712b49409fea.text: On the Switch, friends and family can play party games or compete online.

lxc_206fcb74f3857af1.text: Others enjoy collecting animals for their aquarium and learning about them.

lxc_cff7c0fd280f8e93.text: Some want to finish the story.

lxc_9b62024457544c66.text: Not every player likes the same thing, but the game offers many different kinds of fun.
